cases.name: clip bounds
cases.originalObservedBehavior: The transient invalid-range message was asserted only after later valid edits and Done.
cases.currentObservedBehavior: Immediate 2–2 refusal feedback; original frames/holds/pixels preserved; distinct painted red/blue/green poses and actual clipped GIF prove inclusive 1–2 output, 100/200ms and exclusion of pose 3.
cases.disposition: Not reproduced; assertion order in original execution is invalid for a transient checkpoint. Live playback-clock accuracy remains separate.

cases.name: rectangle and ellipse
cases.originalObservedBehavior: The run never opened the real folded tool flyout; no shape was drawn.
cases.currentObservedBehavior: Actual tool chooser, 12-cell outline rectangle, filled ellipse interior/bounds, single Undo, and selection-mask outside-pixel preservation.
cases.disposition: Not reproduced; control/gesture prerequisite unavailable or not exercised by original runner.

cases.name: Outline Undo
cases.originalObservedBehavior: The original action trace contains Apply Outline but no Undo click before its restoration assertion.
cases.currentObservedBehavior: Actual global Undo restores every native channel; Redo restores Outline in all three engines. A fresh edited-plan portal replay records the real Undo, then retains Blocked for unavailable independent pixel/file observation.
cases.disposition: Original missing-action configuration corrected for one supported UI replay; independent application regression not reproduced. Cloud integrity remains Blocked.

cases.name: quick tools and text input
cases.originalObservedBehavior: The run painted/focused by canvas click, selected Flood Fill instead of the authored Eraser path, and did not exercise text-input isolation.
cases.currentObservedBehavior: Nonpainting focus, actual Shift+F10, all ten dialog tools and swap, Eraser selection/focus, Escape, typed g and Shift+F10 inside rename input; cancelled rename and all pixels intact.
cases.disposition: Not reproduced; original recorded actions drift from the current authored plan.
